item.title: Young truckie puts MC licence to good use behind wheel of K104
item.description: Maddy Ames began her truck driving career about three years ago. Image: Maddy Ames Based at Tamworth in NSW, 27-year-old truckie Maddy Ames drives a Kenworth K104 for Carey’s Freight Lines. Maddy has been a driver for about three years and with Carey’s for the past nine months. “I mainly deliver groceries to Coles and Woolworths supermarkets locally and recently gained my MC licence. item.description: Legislators must urgently expand Australia’s on shore strategic fuel reserves. item.title: $2.1 billion toll-free motorway opens this weekend
item.description: The M12 connects Elizabeth Drive in the east to The Northern Road in the west. Image: Transport for NSW Following four years of construction, a major new 16-kilometre toll-free Sydney motorway will open to traffic in the early hours of the morning this Saturday, March 14. The $2.1 billion M12 Motorway will provide a connection to the new Western Sydney International (Nancy-Bird Walton) Airport, which will begin cargo and passenger flights later this year. item.title: $5.1 million for road maintenance on two key freight corridors
item.description: Works will include spray sealing and resurfacing. Image: Transport for NSW There will be changed traffic conditions in place as work begins to upgrade two important transport corridors in south-east NSW. The NSW Government has committed $5.1 million for road maintenance work on the Monaro Highway and Kosciuszko Road – both critical routes for freight operators travelling through the Snowy Mountains region. item.description: CCTV shows a ute leaving the Killarney depot.
